summary: google.cloud removed the google_cloud_ops_agents role submodule because it blocked sanity and lint tests.
questions: What happened to the google_cloud_ops_agents role in google.cloud?

answer_card.title: google_cloud_ops_agents role removed
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 12.0.0 the `google.cloud` collection removed the **google_cloud_ops_agents** role submodule, because it prevented the collection from passing sanity and lint tests.
